background_fit: normalized Chebyshev basis; SVD least squares; fixed robust lower-outlier clipping
background_stability_check: degrees 5/6/7; convergence, condition number, blocked spatial cross-validation, and degree-6 knife-edge test
negative_control_background: independent radial background, not the fitted polynomial
scope_limit: fixture-informed production-pipeline validation; not general observational or publication-method certification
support_threshold: max(0, outer_annulus_median + 3 * 1.4826 * MAD) on the polynomial-background fractional deficit
